feedbackDispositions.1-clock-clamp: Replaced. clock_decision refuses a wall beyond admittedTime + 90 d (and an in-session deviation over 24 h not proven by a witness) BEFORE evaluation and before any write; a plausible wall evaluates at tEval = max(floor, wall, admitted) and writes exactly tEval. Sweep clock-floor-monotone-no-clamp-report-only-writes-nothing checks 264 grid points (each also evaluated in report-only mode).
feedbackDispositions.2-fresh-install: Replaced. Without admitted time evidence the first evaluation refuses TRUST.NO_ADMITTED_TIME_CONTEXT; with the bootstrap payload it evaluates expiry from the presented documents (never hard-coded false) and refuses a far-future wall without initialising a floor. Report-only returns writes: [] and null write fields. Cases fresh-install-*.
feedbackDispositions.3-poisoned-floor-recovery: Added S4.5: challenge/epoch protocol. Challenge binds a CSPRNG nonce and a digest of the six floor fields; the epoch is signed by the accepted root's recoveryAuthority at its threshold (v3; revoked keys excluded; root keys never count; root expiry not consulted for this one document), must echo the pending single-boot challenge inside its 24 h monotonic window, advance the epoch serial, carry counters EQUAL to the record's, be issued >= lastAccepted and within +/-24 h of the wall. Success sets floor = lastAccepted = issuedAt, leaves counters/entries/roles/journals/namespaces untouched. Artifacts: trust-recovery-challenge.v1.json (export) and trust-recovery-epoch.v1.json (publisher recovery service or air-gap ceremony). 26 cases plus sweep recovery-epoch-applies-once-replay-and-downgrade-refuse.
feedbackDispositions.4-rollback-and-children: Added. Commit records carry postimageSha256; at REV(trust-revoked) rollback happens only when current bytes equal the postimage; otherwise rollbackBlocked (never overwritten) or indeterminate. CHILD steps model unconfined repository code: cancelled within the bound, disclosed, not linearized. Sweep brokered-linearization-and-no-overwrite-of-user-edits.
feedbackDispositions.5-polling-bounds: Restated as implementation qualification obligations under OS scheduling assumptions; observer_tick pins CLOCK_BOOTTIME / mach_continuous_time, the authority checkpoint at every effect request, and fail-stop REV(observer-fail-stop) on stall or unreadable counter. observerCases.
feedbackDispositions.6-canonical-profiles: S2: signed security metadata stays under opensip-metadata-canonical.1 (model.canon); product data uses foundation/canonical.py (checker admits and validates with it). S9 names state-decoder.v1 (read-only source), state-decoder.v2 (writer), root readers {1} vs {1,2}, and the ordered signed core bridge. Sweep metadata-nfc-profile-and-product-profile-never-mixed.
feedbackDispositions.7-completeness-and-tcb-labels: Contract, closed schemas, 234 cases, checker, report and source pins delivered. Every model output that consumes asserted signers or OS reads carries tcbAssumptions; the report lists them; the contract states they are assumptions, not measurements.
feedbackDispositions.8-group-write-and-acl: Group-writable directories and files refuse (boundary at an ancestor, refusal at cwd/explicit/config) unless the gid is authorized by an explicit --trust-group argument; ACL write grants to other principals and unreadable ACLs refuse. 8 new discovery cases.
feedbackDispositions.9-vcs-root-default: A VCS boundary without config selects the repository root (mode vcs-default); nested repositories are recorded and not entered; explicit joins are custody-checked and root-bounded; .git indirection is data and never followed. 7 new discovery cases.
